description_en: Performs a paged query for undeleted assets in a knowledge base based on the file name prefix and processing status. The results are sorted in descending order by the most recent upload time, and then by assetId in descending order for identical upload times. The upload time refers to the acceptance time of the most recent BeginAssetUpload request. It is updated upon overwrite uploads but remains unchanged for replays with the same token or when you deduplicate the source. It does not represent the processing time. The list index is updated asynchronously and may experience brief delays. The totalCount is cached for 60 seconds based on the resource scope and filter conditions, which may result in brief staleness. Stop paging only when nextToken is empty. If the legacy table lacks the upload time column or sorting index, a ServiceUnavailable error is returned. In this case, use a newly created knowledge base
description_zh: 按文件名前缀和处理状态分页查询知识库内未删除的资产，按最近上传时间倒序，同一时间按 assetId 倒序。上传时间取最近一次新上传的 BeginAssetUpload 受理时间，覆盖上传会更新，同 token 重放或来源去重复用不变；不是处理时间。列表索引异步更新，可能有短暂延迟。totalCount 按资源作用域和筛选条件缓存 60 秒，可能短暂陈旧；翻页终止只以 nextToken 为空为准。旧表缺少上传时间列或排序索引时返回 ServiceUnavailable，需使用新建知识库
name: ListAssets

parameters.help_en: Magic parses the tenantId from the trusted gateway call identity and verifies workspace ownership. Knowledge bases are created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. You cannot perform cross-tenant queries by using only the knowledgeBaseId
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The knowledge base whose assets are to be listed
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: Filters assets by the original file name prefix. The maximum length is 255 characters. If this parameter is omitted or left empty, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按原件文件名前缀过滤，最长 255 个字符；省略或空字符串表示不过滤
parameters.name: file_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: Filters assets by their current processing status. If this parameter is omitted, no filtering is applied. Deleted assets are not included in the list. If you set this parameter to DELETED, an empty list is returned
parameters.help_zh: 按资产当前处理状态精确过滤；省略时不过滤。已删除资产不在列表中，status 为 DELETED 时返回空列表
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of assets to return per page. Maximum value: 100. If this parameter is omitted or set to 0, the default value 20 is used
parameters.help_zh: 单页最多返回的资产数，最大 100；省略或传 0 时采用默认值 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The opaque pagination token returned in the previous response. It is a composite cursor based on the upload time and assetId, and is bound to the resource scope and filter conditions. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. If you change the resource or filter conditions, start from the first page. Do not parse or modify the token. If a legacy or cross-scope token is used, an InvalidParameter error is returned. In this case, clear the token and query again. Overwrite uploads change the sorting position, so pagination does not guarantee consistent snapshots across pages
parameters.help_zh: 上一次响应返回的不透明 nextToken；基于上传时间和 assetId 的复合游标，绑定资源作用域及筛选条件。首次不传，更换资源或筛选条件从第一页开始，不得解析或修改；旧版或跨范围 token 返回 InvalidParameter，应清空后重新查询。覆盖上传会移动排序位置，分页不保证跨页快照
parameters.name: next_token

items.description_en: The asset details on the current page, sorted in descending order by the latest upload acceptance time and assetId. Asynchronous index updates may cause brief sorting delays after new uploads or overwrites
items.description_zh: 当前页的资产详情，按最近新上传受理时间、assetId 倒序；索引异步更新可能使新上传或覆盖后的排序短暂滞后

assetId.description_en: The stable ID of the asset. You can specify this ID when creating an asset. If assetId is not specified but clientToken is provided, the platform stably derives the ID based on the resource scope and clientToken. If neither is provided, a new asset is created for each request. Setting overwrite=true allows you to register a new upload session for the same asset, and the previously published version continues to be used until the new result is published
assetId.description_zh: 资产的稳定 ID。新建时可指定；未指定 assetId 但提供 clientToken 时由平台按资源范围和 clientToken 稳定派生，两者均未提供时每次请求创建新资产。overwrite=true 可以为同一资产登记新的上传会话，新结果发布前继续使用旧发布版本

chunkConfiguration.description_en: The effective chunk configuration used for the current asset processing. Explicitly uploaded configurations take precedence over the default values of the knowledge base. Subsequent modifications to the knowledge base configuration do not change this snapshot
chunkConfiguration.description_zh: 本次资产处理使用的有效分块配置。上传显式配置优先于知识库默认值；后续知识库配置修改不改变该快照

headingLevel.description_en: This parameter is required when the strategy is BY_HEADING, and the value ranges from 1 to 6. Headings at or above this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence splitting. Documents without headings fall back to intelligent splitting. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
headingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

maxChunkSize.description_en: The value ranges from 1 to 6000 characters, following the character length standard of EB, not the number of tokens. If this parameter is omitted, the server-side default value is used
maxChunkSize.description_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值

overlapSize.description_en: This parameter takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize, ensuring that the length does not exceed the maximum chunk length after overlapping. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
overlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

preprocessRules.description_en: The text preprocessing rules applied before splitting
preprocessRules.description_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则

removeUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
removeUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址

replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格

separator.description_en: This parameter is required and cannot be empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the entire literal string without using regular expressions. This parameter is ignored for other strategies
separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略

strategy.description_en: The saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates chunking by separator. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for backward compatibility with historical configurations. Only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted when creating or updating configurations in the first phase
strategy.description_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR

chunkCount.description_en: The total number of chunks in the currently published result. This value is 0 before the first publication. During re-chunking or editing, the count still reflects the published result
chunkCount.description_zh: 当前已发布结果的 Chunk 总数，首次发布前为 0；重新分块或编辑处理中仍统计已发布结果

contentType.description_en: The MIME type of the uploaded original file for the asset
contentType.description_zh: 该资产上传原件的 MIME 类型

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format

enabled.description_en: If disabled, the asset does not participate in regular viewing, retrieval, and downloading. Management APIs are still subject to administrative permissions
enabled.description_zh: 禁用后不参与普通查看、检索和下载；管理接口仍受管理权限控制

fileName.description_en: The file name of the currently uploaded original file. Modifying the display name does not change this value
fileName.description_zh: 当前上传原件的文件名；修改显示名称不改变此值

knowledgeBaseId.description_en: The knowledge base to which the asset belongs

lastError.description_en: The masked error of the current upload or processing. This error does not contain internal credentials, paths, or run IDs
lastError.description_zh: 当前上传或处理的脱敏错误；不含内部凭据、路径和运行标识

code.description_en: The stable product error code. This code does not return internal task IDs, stacks, or storage addresses
code.description_zh: 稳定的产品错误码；不返回内部任务标识、堆栈或存储地址

message.description_en: The masked error summary that can be displayed to users
message.description_zh: 可向用户展示的脱敏错误摘要

metadata.description_en: The complete list of effective metadata key-value pairs, including constants and system variable results. Patches involving retrieval projections do not overwrite previous effective values until new results are published
metadata.description_zh: 已生效的完整元数据键值列表，含常量和系统变量结果；涉及检索投影的补丁在新结果发布前不覆盖旧生效值

key.description_en: The field name declared in metadataSchema. It must not be duplicated within the same request. Fixed values and system variable fields are generated by the server and cannot be overwritten by the client
key.description_zh: metadataSchema 中声明的字段名；同一请求中不得重复。固定值及系统变量字段由服务端生成，不接受客户覆盖

value.description_en: The string parsed according to the schema type. If omitted or left empty during upload, it indicates that no value is assigned and the schema populates the value. In UpdateAsset, omitting the field, setting it to null, or providing an empty string deletes the key, while unsubmitted keys remain unchanged. For DATETIME, ISO 8601 with a time zone, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, or yyyy-MM-dd is accepted
value.description_zh: 按 schema 类型解析的字符串。上传时省略或空值表示未赋值，由 schema 填充；UpdateAsset 中省略、null 或空串表示删除该 key，未提交的 key 保持不变。DATETIME 接受 ISO 8601 含时区、yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 或 yyyy-MM-dd

name.description_en: The default value is the uploaded file name. You can call the UpdateAsset operation to modify the display name
name.description_zh: 默认采用上传文件名，可通过 UpdateAsset 修改显示名称

publishedResultAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether the published result is available. The value is true if a published version exists and the asset is neither disabled nor deleted. The value may still be true if re-chunking or editing fails, and is false if the first processing fails
publishedResultAvailable.description_zh: 已发布版本存在且资产未禁用、未删除时为 true；重新分块或编辑失败时可能仍为 true，首次处理失败时为 false

sizeBytes.description_en: The size of the current original file in bytes. This value is not returned before the upload is confirmed. After confirmation, the actual size verified by the OSS HEAD request is returned
sizeBytes.description_zh: 当前原件字节数；上传确认前不返回，确认后返回经 OSS HEAD 校验的实际大小

sourceModifiedTime.description_en: The last modification time of the source file in UTC epoch milliseconds. This value is not returned if it is not provided
sourceModifiedTime.description_zh: 源文件最后修改时间，UTC epoch 毫秒；未提供时不返回

sourceType.description_en: The import channel of the asset, such as UPLOAD or OSS. This value is recorded by the platform based on the trusted access path and is not used to grant access permissions
sourceType.description_zh: 资产导入渠道，如 UPLOAD、OSS；由平台根据可信接入路径记录，不用于授予访问权限

sourceUri.description_en: The URI of the original file source. This value is used only for tracing, does not authorize downloads, and does not trigger server-side fetching
sourceUri.description_zh: 原件来源的 URI，仅用于溯源，不是下载授权，也不触发服务端抓取

status.description_en: The current upload or processing status of the document. Uploads, rebuilds, and chunk body edits are polled by using the GetAsset operation. PENDING indicates waiting for processing, PROCESSING indicates processing, COMPLETED indicates that the publication is complete, and FAILED indicates a final failure and returns lastError. This status does not represent the result of a specific historical request. No readable result is available if the first processing fails. During overwrite uploads, rebuilds, or edits, and after failures, the published result remains readable if the enabled and deletion statuses allow it
status.description_zh: 文档当前上传或处理状态。上传、重建和 Chunk 正文编辑均通过 GetAsset 轮询；PENDING 为等待处理，PROCESSING 为正在处理，完成发布后为 COMPLETED，最终失败为 FAILED 并返回 lastError。不表示某次历史请求的结果。首次处理失败没有可读结果；覆盖上传、重建或编辑期间以及失败后，已发布结果在启用和删除状态允许时仍可读

updatedAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format

workspaceId.description_en: The workspace to which the asset belongs

maxResults.description_en: The page size used for the current request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求采用的分页大小

message.description_en: The description of the masked result

nextToken.description_en: Pass this value as is to continue pagination. If this value is empty, pagination ends. Do not use totalCount to determine the next page. Cross-page snapshots are not guaranteed during concurrent uploads, overwrites, deletions, or status changes
nextToken.description_zh: 继续分页时原样传入；为空时结束，不使用 totalCount 判断下一页。并发上传、覆盖、删除或状态变化时不保证跨页快照

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

totalCount.description_en: The count of undeleted assets that meet the file name prefix and status filter conditions of the current request. This count is cached for 60 seconds based on the resource scope and filter conditions, and may be briefly stale. The first request after a cold cache or expiration synchronously scans the count. Concurrent scans do not guarantee transactional snapshots or exact consistency with the current page, and cannot be used for quota verification or determining the next page
totalCount.description_zh: 满足本次文件名前缀和状态过滤条件的未删除资产计数；按资源作用域及筛选条件缓存 60 秒，可能短暂陈旧。冷缓存或过期后首次请求同步扫描计数，并发扫描不保证事务快照，不保证与当前页完全一致，不能用于额度校验或判断下一页
